The inconclusive verdicts were caused entirely by tool/API errors, not by any security concerns in the packaging.
disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from tool errors rather than security findings. learnings: Implement automatic retries for transient API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent non-executable files like .gitignore from forcing an inconclusive package verdict when other files are safe.
Ensure models that fail to parse their own output do not unnecessarily trigger or prolong audit workflows, especially when they are flagged as advisory.
